text:
incidents-bot: PAGER — detected spike in Stripe webhook failures (401 + 429) for webhooks-ingest. Error rate crossed paging threshold at ~2026-03-15T10:00:00Z. Paging emily (oncall). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/stripe-webhook-failures :rotating_light:

emily (oncall): acked, joining bridge. Can someone confirm scope (merchant count / failure code breakdown)?

raj (sre): seeing a mix of 401 + 429 from Stripe API responses in the logs. 401s show "invalid_api_key" and 429s show rate limit. Spike started ~09:58 UTC and peaked ~10:01. Rough numbers: ~27% failures across webhooks-ingest in last 5m.

marta (eng-infra): tagging infra. We pushed a small agent change last night that rotates our Stripe service key on a schedule. Possible token mismatch during rotation?

jordan (support-ops): customer impact: currently 12 merchants with failed webhook deliveries, 3 merchants showing billing paused in our UI. One enterprise customer (acme-inc) reported lost invoices. Collecting list, will attach.

emily (oncall): ok immediate mitigation plan proposals: 1) flip webhook retry logic to 'poll fallback' for merchants with persistent 401s so they can get events, 2) temporarily disable key-rotation triggers for Stripe service key, 3) open escalation with Stripe (account team) for quota/unpause.

raj (sre): going to enable polling fallback for affected tenants now. Polling worker command (running in k8s):
```bash
kubectl -n services exec deploy/polling-worker -- /bin/sh -c '
for id in $(cat /tmp/affected_tenants); do 
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $LEGACY_STRIPE_KEY" https://api.stripe.com/v1/events?limit=100 | jq .; 
done
'
```
Note: LEGACY_STRIPE_KEY referenced, ensure it's the non-rotated key from vault.

marta (eng-infra): rolling back rotation config now. Patch applied to infra-config v2.4.1 — disabling rotation until we confirm stable key.

deploy-bot: deploy "polling-worker-hotfix" succeeded in staging and prod (10:07 UTC).

jordan (support-ops): posted draft to status page: "We are experiencing issues delivering webhooks to a subset of customers due to an upstream Stripe auth and rate-limiting issue. We are implementing a temporary polling fallback and working with Stripe to restore normal delivery. Updates to follow."

lee (product): prepare two comms: 1) high-level status for status.redwood.ai, 2) targeted email for affected enterprise customers. Jordan can you prepare enterprise note and include remediation ETA?

stripe-ops-rep: we've identified that some webhook replays triggered multiple failed auth attempts and automated throttling on our side flagged the merchant accounts. We can temporarily unpause affected merchants if you provide the merchant IDs. Also confirming whether your key rotation triggered an auth break — we see many 401s referencing "invalid_api_key".

emily (oncall): sending merchant IDs now (via secure DM). Jordan, collect list and DM to stripe-ops-rep. Raj, continue polling fallback and monitor success rate. Marta keep rotation off.

raj (sre): polling fallback enabled for all 12 merchants. Early success: 9/12 merchants have >95% of missed events pulled and delivered to customers' ingestion endpoints. Two merchants still showing 401s on delivery; investigating endpoint config.

marta (eng-infra): confirmed rotation disabled and rollback committed. Key in vault reverted to previous value at 10:12 UTC.

jordan (support-ops): stripe-ops-rep confirmed unpause for 3 merchants at 10:15 UTC. Support cases updated with remediation entries. Draft enterprise email ready, will send after emily approves.

emily (oncall): interim incident summary: cause likely transient key rotation + automated quota enforcement at Stripe due to repeated failed deliveries. Mitigations: polling fallback enabled, rotation rollback, Stripe unpaused affected merchants, status page updated, support notified. Next steps: 1) full post-incident review, 2) tighten rotation tooling to avoid breaking in-flight deliveries, 3) add telemetry to detect key mismatch before rotation.

lee (product): add product-owner review to postmortem: impact to billing and invoice delivery needs priority fixes.

raj (sre): handing off active monitoring to oncall second (marta) at 10:20 UTC. I'll stay on infra channel for followups.

marta (eng-infra): acknowledged handoff, will monitor delivery success metrics and health dashboard for next 2 hours. If error rate creeps >5% will re-escalate.

emily (oncall): thanks team. closing bridge once metrics stable for 30m. Will file incident report and link here.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status: mitigated (10:32 UTC). Please add any missing notes to the runbook.
